R01-1-A.label: N
R01-1-A.query: A contract of sales concluded by a minor may not be rescinded if it relates to daily life, even in cases the consent of the parental authority is not obtained.

R01-1-I.label: Y
R01-1-I.query: A contract of sales concluded by an adult ward may be rescinded except relating to daily life, even in cases the consent of the adult guardian has been obtained, the contract

R01-1-U.label: Y
R01-1-U.query: A contract of guarantee concluded by a person under curatorship may not be rescinded in cases the consent of the curator is obtained.

R01-1-E.label: Y
R01-1-E.query: An act which requires the consent of the assistant may be rescinded if the person under assistance performed it without such consent or the permission of family court in lieu thereof.

R01-1-O.label: N
R01-1-O.query: The period of the extinctive prescription of the right to rescind about the act performed by an adult ward commences from the time of becoming a person with capacity to act.

R01-2-A.label: Y
R01-2-A.query: The family court appointed B as the administrator of the property of absentee A, as A went missing without appointing the one. In cases where A owns land X, B needs to obtains the permission of a family court in order to sell Land X as an agent of A.

R01-2-I.label: Y
R01-2-I.query: The family court appointed B as the administrator of the property of absentee A, as A went missing without appointing the one. In cases where cash owned by A is discovered, B doesn't need to obtain the permission of a family when depositing in A's saving account of Bank D as an agent of A.

R01-2-U.label: Y
R01-2-U.query: The family court appointed B as the administrator of the property of absentee A, as A went missing without appointing the one. In cases where A has the debt obligation which is due against E, B doesn't need to obtain the permission of a family court when paying it to E for the benefit of A.

R01-2-E.label: N
R01-2-E.query: The family court appointed B as the administrator of the property of absentee A, as A went missing without appointing the one. In cases where A is one of the joint heirs of decendent F, B doesn't need to obtain the permission of a family court when dividing inherited F's property by agreement between the other joint heirs as an agent of A.

R01-2-O.label: N
R01-2-O.query: The family court appointed B as the administrator of the property of absentee A, as A went missing without appointing the one. In cases where A has child G, B doesn't need to obtain the permission of a family court when donating marriage fund to G as an agent of A.

R01-3-A.label: N
R01-3-A.query: In case where A's agent B concluded the contract with C  within the scope of such authority without indication that it is made on behalf of A, it will not be effective between A and C unless C knows that the B is acting on behalf of A.

R01-3-I.label: Y
R01-3-I.query: In case where A obtains the permission from B and C in advance, A will conclude the contract between B and C as the agent of both

R01-3-E.label: Y
R01-3-E.query: In cases where a statutory agent may appoint a sub-agent by any unavoidable reason, it shall assume only the responsibility vis-a-vis the principal for the appointment and supervision of such sub-agent.

R01-3-O.label: N
R01-3-O.query: When An unauthorized agent acted believing that it had had authority of agency without negligence, it shall not be liable to the counterparty for the performance of the contract or damages even if it is unable to obtain the ratification of the principal.

R01-4-I.label: Y
R01-4-I.query: While it is uncertain whether or not a condition has been fulfilled, the rights and obligations of the party concerned may be disposed of, inherited or preserved, or any security may be provided therefor, in accordance with the usual provisions of the law.

R01-4-U.label: N
R01-4-U.query: Juristic act subject to a condition subsequent which is impossible is impossible shall be void.

R01-4-E.label: Y
R01-4-E.query: In cases any party who will suffer any detriment as a result of the fulfillment of a condition intentionally prevents the fulfillment of such condition, the counterparty may deem that such condition has been fulfilled.

R01-4-O.label: N
R01-4-O.query: A juristic act which is subject to a condition precedent shall be void if the condition is dependent upon the will of the obligor.

R01-5-E.label: N
R01-5-E.query: A person who possesses his/her own thing may not invoke acquisitive prescription of it.

R01-5-O.label: Y
R01-5-O.query: In cases where a person asserts more than two possessions succeeded together with his/her own by the change of possessors, whether or not he/she is in good faith and without negligence is decided shall be judged by the first possessor at the time of the commencement of the possession.

R01-6-A.label: Y
R01-6-A.query: In cases A sold Land X belonging to A and B sold it to C, C may be asserted against A about ownership of Land X for sales without special security.

R01-6-I.label: N
R01-6-I.query: In cases B was bequeathed land X by A, B may be asserted against D about ownership of Land X for bequest without special security when C's obligee D amongst joint heirs attached C's share and registered because of joint succession to Land X.

R01-7-I.label: N
R01-7-I.query: A allowed B to retain movable X. B died and an only heir D started to possess X actually believing that it belongs to B's inherited property without negligence.In cases X is a jewel, D may acquire ownership of X immediately.

R01-7-U.label: Y
R01-7-U.query: A allowed B to retain movable X. B donated X to E and E was delivered actually believing that it belongs to B  without negligence.In cases X is a jewel, E may acquire ownership of X immediately.

R01-7-E.label: Y
R01-7-E.query: A allowed B to retain movable X. X is auctioned compulsorily by B' obligee, F bought it and F was delivered actually believing that it belongs to B  without negligence.In cases X is a jewel, E may acquire ownership of X immediately.

R01-7-O.label: Y
R01-7-O.query: A allowed B to retain movable X. B pledged X to G and was delivered actually believing that it belongs to B without negligence. In cases X is a jewel, E may acquire pledge of X immediately.

R01-8-A.label: Y
R01-8-A.query: In cases seeds, which had been sowed based on no title to using and making profits from land, grew into seedlings,ownership of the seedings shall vest in the owners of it.

R01-8-O.label: Y
R01-8-O.query: If a processor uses only other's woods as materials and contributes work to them, the processor shall acquire ownership of the thing when the value derived from the work significantly exceeds the value of the materials.

R01-9-A.label: N
R01-9-A.query: If the partition of land which A and B co-owns creates a parcel of A's Land X that has no access to public roads and B's Land Y that has access to public roads, A may pass to the public roads from Land X through Land Z when passing through Land Z cause the least damage.

R01-9-I.label: Y
R01-9-I.query: If land suffers damage due to destruction or blockage of a culvert installed on neighboring land to discharge or draw water, the owner of that land may have the owners of such neighboring lands repair or remove the it.

R01-9-U.label: N
R01-9-U.query: If a tree or bamboo branch from neighboring land crosses a boundary line, the landowner may sever that branch by nis/her own.

R01-9-E.label: Y
R01-9-E.query: Boundary markers installed on boundary lines shall be presumed to be co-owned by the neighbors.

R01-9-O.label: Y
R01-9-O.query: A landowner may install boundary markers, sharing the expenses with the owner of the neighboring land.

R01-10-A.label: N
R01-10-A.query: A, B and C co-own Building X at the rate of one-third each. A needs to obtain the consent of B and C if A create a mortgage in the share.

R01-10-O.label: Y
R01-10-O.query: A, B and C co-own Building X at the rate of one-third each. If A holds a claim regarding administration of Building X, A may exercise a claim also against F when B transfer the share to F.

R01-11-A.label: N
R01-11-A.query: A holder of rights of retention may lease subject real estate without obtaining the consent of the obligor.

R01-11-I.label: Y
R01-11-I.query: In order to preserve the effectiveness of statutory liens for preservation of immovable properties, registration must be carried out immediately after the completion of the act of preservation.

R01-11-E.label: Y
R01-11-E.query: Pledgees of immovable properties can demand interest on their claims in cases where the acts establishing pledges provide otherwise.

R01-12-A.label: Y
R01-12-A.query: If a holder of the right of retention loses a object material, the detention right disappears.

R01-12-I.label: N
R01-12-I.query: A possessor of a thing belonging to another person may retain that thing even if a claim that has arisen with respect to that thing has not yet fallen due.

R01-12-U.label: Y
R01-12-U.query: An obligor may demand that a right of retention be extinguished by tendering reasonable security.

R01-12-O.label: N
R01-12-O.query: In cases where A sold C Building X he/she owns and registerd with respect to it after delivering Building X to B, B may may retain Building X to secure a claim for damages due to default if C demanded vacation of Building X from B.

R1-13-A.label: N
R1-13-A.query: A pledgee of claim may not colllect the claim directly, when the subject matter of the pledge of claim is not a monetary claim.

R1-13-I.label: Y
R1-13-I.query: A pledgee of movables may receive the profits from the movable property, and reimburse secured debt by the profits prior to other creditors.

R1-13-U.label: N
R1-13-U.query: A pledgee may not further create a pledge with respect to the subject matter of the pledge as collateral for his debt without the consent of the pledgor.

R1-13-E.label: N
R1-13-E.query: Demand damages arising from latent defect in the subject matter of a pledge is not secured by a pledge, when the contract clause is not concluded.

R1-13-O.label: Y
R1-13-O.query: A obligor (A) may create a pledge with respect to a claim vested in the obligee (B) against the obligor (A) to secure (A)'s claim ageinst (B).

R1-14-A.label: Y
R1-14-A.query: A mortgage may also be exercised against the claim for damage that the obligor is to receive as a result of the loss of the subject matter of the mortgage.

R1-14-I.label: Y
R1-14-I.query: In cases where two buildings which are owned by one person that the distinction of principal and accessory cannot be made between become one building due to the construction, if mortgages are created with respect to the two buildings respectively, the mortgages shall own each mortage on the building in proportion to the respective price continuedly.

R1-14-U.label: N
R1-14-U.query: In cases where a mortgage is created with respect to a building on leased land, the mortgage may not be exercised against the right of lease.

R1-14-E.label: N
R1-14-E.query: A contract to creat a mortgage to secure a claim to delivery movables  has no effect.

R1-14-O.label: Y
R1-14-O.query: In cases where a mortgage is created to secure a claim that may arise in the future and registrated, if the claime arises actually, the mortgage secure it effectively.

R1-15-A.label: N
R1-15-A.query: In cases where a mortgagor lease land which is a subject matter of the mortgage to a person, the mortgage shall extend to the rent without a default with respect to a claim secured by the mortgage.

R1-15-I.label: Y
R1-15-I.query: In cases where a mortgage is created with respect to land by the owner of the land, if trees are planted and logged on the land, the mortgage shall entend to the trees.

R1-15-U.label: N
R1-15-U.query: In cases where a mortgagor has juwels in the bluilding which is the subject matter of the mortgage, the mortgage shall entend to the juwels.

R1-15-E.label: N
R1-15-E.query: In cases where a building which is the subject matter of a mortgage collapses and becomes movables, the mortgage shall entend to the movables.

R1-15-O.label: Y
R1-15-O.query: In cases where a person who lease a building which is the subject matter of a mortgage from the mortgagor installs his own air- conditioner which is removabe, the mortgage shall not extend to the air-conditioner.

R1-16-U.label: N
R1-16-U.query: In cases where a mortgagor did not perform his obligation until the time of performance, if the mortgagee transfers his/her mortgaged real properties to a third party, the mortgagor may not assert a right of retention to secure settlement claims against the mortgagee when the third party claims the delivery of the mortgaged real properties.

R1-17-A.label: Y
R1-17-A.query: No contract of guarantee shall be effective unless it is made in writing or concluded by electromagnetic record which records the contents thereof.

R1-17-I.label: N
R1-17-I.query: A guarantor need to be a person with the capacity to act, even if the obligee has designated the guarantor.

R1-17-U.label: N
R1-17-U.query: A contract for revolving guarantee on loans shall be invalid, in the cases where it does not provide a principal determination date.

R1-17-O.label: Y
R1-17-O.query: Where a guarantor may demand the obligee to demand performance of the principal obligor first, if the obligee fails to demand and is subsequently unable to obtain full performance from the principal obligor, the guarantor shall be relieved of liability to the extent that the obligee would have received performance if the obligee had immediately demanded.

R1-18-U.label: Y
R1-18-U.query: In the cases where the obligor has given the acknowledgement referred to the assignment of a claim of remuneration receivables related to unfinished work which the obligor cntracts out to the contractor, if the assignee knows that the claim is remuneration receivables related to unfinished work, the obligor may refuse to perform his/her obligation by asserting the cancellation right of the contract against the assignee.

R1-18-E.label: N
R1-18-E.query: The order of priority of the assignment of a claim and the attachment of the same claim shall follow  the order of the time when the requirements for the assertion of the assignment against third parties expect the pobligor is met and the time when the attachment order is issued.

R1-19-A.label: N
R1-19-A.query: the obligee(B) may not manifests his/her intention to release an obligation to the obligor(A) against the will of the obligor(A).

R1-19-I.label: Y
R1-19-I.query: A third party may guarantee monetary debts which the obligor(A) contracts with the obligee(B) against the will of the obligor(A).

R1-19-U.label: N
R1-19-U.query: Third person mortgagor who secures the monetary debts which the obligor(A) contract with the obligee(B) may not perform the obligation against the will of the obligor(A).

R1-19-E.label: Y
R1-19-E.query: The obligee(B) and a third party(C) may not replace the obligor(A) who contracts monetary debts with the obligee(B) to the third party(C) for by novation against the will of the obligor(A).

R1-19-O.label: N
R1-19-O.query: The obligee(B) may not perform the obligation which he/she contracts with a third party by assigning the claim which the obligor(A) contracts with the obligee(B) to the third party as a substitute against the will of the obligor(A).

R1-20-A.label: N
R1-20-A.query: In cases where the credit of sale value is assigned to the assignee with the requirements for assertion of the assignment, the tender of the performance by the obligor shall be sufficient if it is exercised at the place the assignor lives at the time.

R1-20-I.label: Y
R1-20-I.query: In cases where the seller of the specified things retains them at the place where he/she lives since he/she entered into the contract for sale, the tender of the performance shall be sufficient if the seller demands that the buyer accepts the subject matters by giving a notice that the delivery has been prepared.

R1-21-A.label: N
R1-21-A.query: That a third party assumes a monetary debt jointly and severally with a debtor after the debtor has entered into the loans for consumption is a novation.

R1-21-I.label: Y
R1-21-I.query: A novation by substitution of obligee may not be asserted against a third party unless it is made using an instrument bearing a fixed date.

R1-21-U.label: Y
R1-21-U.query: In cases where a mortgage is created to secure an guarantee obligation, the guarantee obligation is not extinguished  when a guarantor assumes the position of the principal obligor at the time the death of the principal obligor.

R1-21-E.label: N
R1-21-E.query: To the extent of the purpose of the obligation in effect prior to the novation, the parties to the novation may convert the mortgage created as the security of such obligation by a third party to the obligation in effect after the novation without consent of the third party.

R1-21-O.label: Y
R1-21-O.query: In cases where the lessee(B) continually possesses the building X which is the subject matter of the lease after transfering it from the lessor(A), if a person(C) acquires it from the lessor(A) and subsequently registers the transfer of ownership from the lessor(A) to (C), the lessee(B) may not assert the acquirement of the ownership of the building X against (C). In such case, the lessee(B) may asserts the right of the lease of the building X against (C).

R1-22-A.label: N
R1-22-A.query: In case a mandate made for a consideration, a mandator's obligation of payment for remuneration and the mandatary's obligation to administer the mandated business shall have the relationship of simutaneous performances.

R1-22-I.label: Y
R1-22-I.query: In a buyer has cancelled the seles contract of the building which is not registered yet because of a latent defect of it, the seller'obligation of reimbursement and the buyer's obligation to return the building have the relationship of simutaneous performances.

R1-22-E.label: Y
R1-22-E.query: In cases where a minor has rescinded a movable sale contract without the consent of his/her statutory agent, the seller'obligation of reimbursement and the buyer's obligation to return the subject matter of the sele have the relationship of simutaneous performances.

R1-23-2.label: N
R1-23-2.query: A quasi-loan has no effect if the the borrower do not deliver the subject matter of the quasi-loan to the lender.

R1-23-3.label: N
R1-23-3.query: No contract of loan for use shall be effective unless it is made in writing.

R1-23-4.label: N
R1-23-4.query: No contract of deposit shall be effective unless the depositor promises the depositary to pay remuneration.

R1-23-5.label: Y
R1-23-5.query: The subject of the contribution may not be money only.

R1-24-A.label: Y
R1-24-A.query: (A) and (B) agreed that (A) sell the used bicycle which (A) owned (hereinafter referred to as P) to (B) on April 1 with the provision for the delivery on april 10 and the payment on April 20. (P) was lost due to reasons attributable to (B) on April 8. In such case, (b) may not refuse the payment when (A) claims the payment from (B) on April 20.

R1-24-I.label: Y
R1-24-I.query: (A) and (B) agreed that (A) sell the used bicycle which (A) owned (hereinafter referred to as P) to (B) on April 1 with the provision for the delivery on april 10 and the payment on April 20. (P) has a latent defect which is created before the sale, but (A) delivered (P) to (B) on April 10. In such case, (B) may cancel the sale, if (B) cannot achieve his/her purpose of the sale on account of the defect.

R1-24-U.label: N
R1-24-U.query: (A) and (B) agreed that (A) sell the used bicycle which (A) owned (hereinafter referred to as P) to (B) on April 1 with the provision for the delivery on april 10 and the payment on April 20. (A) delivered (P) to (B) on April 10. But (B) did not pay even after April 20, sell (P) to (C) who did not know the sale which (A) and (B) entered into and deliverd (P) to (C). In such case, (A) may cancell the sale and claim the delivery of (P) against (C), if (B) did not pay after (A) demanded the payment.

R1-24-E.label: Y
R1-24-E.query: (A) and (B) agreed that (A) sell the used bicycle which (A) owned (hereinafter referred to as P) to (B) on April 1 with the provision for the delivery on april 10 and the payment on April 20. (B) claimed the delivery of (P) against (A) without the tender of the payment on April 21 because (A) had not delivered (P) to (B) on April 20. In such case, (A) may refuse the claim of the delivery based on rights of defense of simultaneous performance.

R1-24-O.label: N
R1-24-O.query: (A) and (B) agreed that (A) sell the used bicycle which (A) owned (hereinafter referred to as P) to (B) on April 1 with the provision for the delivery on april 10 and the payment on April 20. (A) delivered (P) to (B) on April 25, but (B) did not pay for (A). In such case, (A) may demand the cost of (P) and interest on the purchase which (B) assumes an obligation to pay from April 21.

R01-25-A.label: N
R01-25-A.query: A lease becomes effective only when in writing.

R01-25-I.label: Y
R01-25-I.query: The duration of a lease may not exceed twenty years.

R01-25-U.label: Y
R01-25-U.query: Even if the parties specify the term of a lease, the lessor may request to terminate it at any time if he/she reserves the right to terminate during that period.

R01-25-E.label: Y
R01-25-E.query: In cases where a lessee continues to make use of the land after the expiration of the term of the lease, if a lessor who knows of the same raises no objection, it shall be presumed that a further lease is entered into under conditions identical to those of the previous lease.

R01-25-O.label: N
R01-25-O.query: In cases where the parties do not specify the term of a lease, if either party requests to terminate it, it shall be cancelled at the time of the arrival of the notice of termination to the other party.

R01-26-A.label: Y
R01-26-A.query: If there is no significant defect in the subject matter of work and excessive costs would be required for the repair, the party ordering the work may not demand that the contractor repair the defect.

R01-26-I.label: Y
R01-26-I.query: Even if there is a defect in the subject matter of work and the party ordering the work may demand that the contractor repair it, the party ordering the work may demand compensation for damages in lieu of the repair of the defect.

R01-26-U.label: N
R01-26-U.query: In cases where the defect in the subject matter of the work arises due to the instructions given by the party ordering the work, even if the contractor knew that the instructions were inappropriate but did not disclose the same, he/she does not have an warranty against defects.

R01-26-E.label: N
R01-26-E.query: When one of the parties contracts to build, the demand for repair by the other must be made within one year from the time of the completion of work.

R01-26-O.label: Y
R01-26-O.query: Even if the contractor agrees to a special agreement to the effect that the contractor will not be liable for the warranty against defects, the contractor may not be released from the contractor's liability with respect to facts the contractor knew and did not disclose.

R01-28-A.label: Y
R01-28-A.query: If any defect in the installation or preservation of any structure on land caused damages to others and A as the possessor of such structure shall be liable to the victims to compensate for those damages, when A compensated for those damages, A may have a right to remedy over against B who shall be liable for the damages.

R01-28-I.label: N
R01-28-I.query: Even if any defect in the planting or support of A's trees caused damages to B, if A managed them with reasonable care, A shall not be liable to compensate for the damages.

R01-28-U.label: Y
R01-28-U.query: If any defect in the installation or preservation of X building that A owns caused damages to B, even if the defect had arisen when the previous owner had owned X building, A as the possessor of X building shall be liable to compensate for those damages to B.

R01-28-E.label: N
R01-28-E.query: If A leased and transfered X building that A owns to B , B subleased and transfered it to C, B as the possessor shall not be liable to the third party to compensate for damages which any defect in the installation or preservation of X building caused.

R01-28-O.label: N
R01-28-O.query: In cases where any defect in the installation or preservation of any structure on land caused damages to A,if B who possesses such structure shall be liable to compensate for those damages, the owner must compensate for the damages too when B has no financial resources.

R01-31-A.label: Y
R01-31-A.query: With respect to any right which either husband or wife has vis-a-vis the other spouse, the prescription shall not be completed during marriage.

R01-36-A.label: N
R01-36-A.query: The authority of agency shall not be terminated upon the death of the principal.

R01-36-I.label: N
R01-36-I.query: When the depositor died, if the timing of the return is specified, the depositary may return the deposited goods prior to the due date.

R01-36-U.label: Y
R01-36-U.query: Loans for use shall not lose its effect on the death of the lender.

R01-36-E.label: Y
R01-36-E.query: Partners shall withdraw if the partner dies.

R01-37-A.label: N
R01-37-A.query: In cases where the subject of a claim is the delivery of any specified things, the obligor must take custody of such property with due care of a prudent manager until the completion of such delivery, even if the obligee refuses, or is unable, to accept the tender of the performance of any obligation.

R01-37-I.label: Y
R01-37-I.query: The obligation for the preservation which the obligor contracts with the obligee until the delivery of the specific thing can be reduced with a special contract.

R01-37-U.label: N
R01-37-U.query: A donor shall assume a duty to retain the subject matter exercising care identical to that he/she exercises for his/her own property until the completion of such delivery.

R02-1-A.label: N
R02-1-A.query: The family court may decide to commence an assistance also in respect of a person whose capacity to appreciate their own situation is extremely inadequate due to a mental disorder.

R02-1-I.label: N
R02-1-I.query: The issuance of a decision for commencement of assistance at the request of a person other than the person in question requires the consent of the person in question unless the family court finds it to be suitable.

R02-1-U.label: N
R02-1-U.query: If the grounds of commencement of assistance cease to exist, the family court may rescind the decision for commencement of assistance without any party's request.

R02-1-E.label: Y
R02-1-E.query: If the assistant does not consent to an act for which the person under assistance must obtain the assistant's consent even though it is unlikely to prejudice the interests of the person under assistance, the family court may grant permission that operates in lieu of the assistant's consent, at the request of the person under assistance.

R02-2-E.label: N
R02-2-E.query: A foreign juridical person permitted possesses the same private rights even if a foreign national is not entitled to enjoy the rights as those possessed by a juridical person of the same kind that has been formed in Japan.

R02-3-A.label: N
R02-3-A.query: With respect to the rescission of a manifestation of intention on the ground of a mistake, whether the mistake is material or not is decided on the basis of the person making the manifestation of intention.

R02-3-I.label: N
R02-3-I.query: If an act that may be rescinded by a person (A) who made the defective manifestation of intention on the ground of A's mistake, the act is also voidable by the counterparty (B).

R02-3-U.label: Y
R02-3-U.query: If a gift without burden was rescinded on the ground of a mistake by the donor (A), but the donee (B) had already received the payment or delivery based on the gift contract, and B did not know at the time of receiving the payment or delivery that the gift contract was voidable, B has an obligation to return to the extent currently enriched.

R02-3-O.label: N
R02-3-O.query: In the case a manifestation of intention of A to B is based on a mistake and the mistake is due to gross negligence on the part of A, A may not rescind the manifestation of intention, unless B knew, or did not know due to gross negligence, of the mistake on the part of A.

R02-4-A.label: N
R02-4-A.query: A, who acts as the agent of B, concluded a contract with C for sale of land owned by B. However, A had no authority to represent to conclude the contract. A is liable for the performance of the contract or compensation for loss or damage, as chosen by A.

R02-4-I.label: Y
R02-4-I.query: A, who acts as the agent of B, concluded a contract with C for sale of land owned by B. However, A had no authority to represent to conclude the contract. If B ratifies the contract of sales, A is not liable to C as an unauthorized agency.

R02-4-U.label: N
R02-4-U.query: A, who acts as the agent of B, concluded a contract with C for sale of land owned by B. However, A had no authority to represent to conclude the contract. In the case that C was negligent in not knowing that A had no authority to represent, even if A knew themselves to have no authority to represent, A is not liable to C as an unauthorized agency.

R02-5-A.label: Y
R02-5-A.query: A claim for damage due to non-performance is extinguished by prescription,if the obligee does not exercise the right within five years from the time when the obligee came to know that it was exercisable.

R02-5-I.label: N
R02-5-I.query: The right to rescind an act induced by fraud is extinguished by prescription, if the obligee does not exercise the right within five years from the time of the act.

R02-5-U.label: Y
R02-5-U.query: The claim for compensation for loss or damage in torts is extinguished by prescription, if the obligee does not exercise the right within 20 years from the time of the tortious act.

R02-5-E.label: N
R02-5-E.query: If a right for which a period of prescription shorter than 10 years is provided is determined by a final and binding judgment, the period of prescription of the right is shorter one.

R02-5-O.label: Y
R02-5-O.query: A claim for periodic payments is extinguished by prescription, if the obligee does not exercise each claim for the delivery of things such as money arising from the claim for periodic payments within 10 years from the time when the obligee comes to know that each claim is exercisable.

R02-8-E.label: Y
R02-8-E.query: A took the jewelry that B had forgotten, believing without negligence that it belonged to A. In this case, A may not obtain the ownership of the jewelry by good faith acquisition.

R02-8-O.label: Y
R02-8-O.query: A stole the jewelry that B had leased from C, and gave it to D. If D received the actual delivery of the jewelry believing without negligence that it belonged to A, B may demand the return of the jewelry from D within two years from the time of the theft.

R02-9-A.label: N
R02-9-A.query: A has leased a copying machine owned by A to B, and B has not returned it by using it even after the termination of the lease agreement. In this case, A may demand the return of the copying machine against B by filing an action for recovery of possession.

R02-9-I.label: Y
R02-9-I.query: B stole A's computer with a sticker "Owner A" on the bottom. B transferred the computer to C who does not know the theft, without changing the computer's appearance. In this case, A may not demand the return of the computer by filing an action for recovery of possession.

R02-9-U.label: Y
R02-9-U.query: A has leased a machine tool owned by A to B, and C stole the machine tool from B within the duration of the lease agreement. In this case, B may file an action for recovery of possession against C independently of A.

R02-9-E.label: N
R02-9-E.query: B obtained A's bicycle by fraud. In this case, A may demand the return of the bicycle against B by filing an action for recovery of possession.

R02-9-O.label: Y
R02-9-O.query: A had owned land in an area of holiday homes. B, who owned neighboring land, began to construct a fence on A's land crossing the boundary without A's consent, and two years later the fence was completed. As of this time, A may not demand the removal of the fence against B by filing an action for maintenance of possession.

R02-10-I.label: N
R02-10-I.query: The duration of agreed superficies must be fixed within a duration of 20 years or more but not more than 50 years.

R02-10-U.label: Y
R02-10-U.query: Superficies are the rights to use a land in order to own structures, or trees or bamboo.

R02-10-E.label: Y
R02-10-E.query: An underground space or airspace may be established as the subject matter of superficies for ownership of structures, through the specification of upper and lower extents.

R02-11-E.label: Y
R02-11-E.query: In order to preserve the effectiveness of statutory liens for construction work for immovables, the budgeted expenses of the construction work must be registered prior to the commencement of the same.

R02-12-A.label: N
R02-12-A.query: An obligor (A) created a mortgage for an obligee (B) on the real property owned by A and the creation was registered. A may assert the extinctive prescription of the mortgage if 20 years have passed from the time when it becomes exercisable, even if the claim the mortgage secures is not extinguished.

R02-13-A.label: N
R02-13-A.query:
Suppose that obligator (A) sets a mortgage on his real estate for obligee (B).
An obligee (B) may assign the order of priority of a mortgage to another obligee(C) of obligator (A) before the principal is crystallized.

R02-13-E.label: N
R02-13-E.query:
Suppose that obligator (A) sets a mortgage on his real estate for obligee (B).
If there is a subordinated mortgagee(F), in order for A and B to effect the changes of the principal crystallization date of the revolving mortgage, the consent of F must be obtained.

R02-15-I.label: N
R02-15-I.query: The contract for sale does not become effective in the case where X is burned down the day before the day of the conclusion of the contract.

R02-15-U.label: Y
R02-15-U.query: If, after the conclusion of the contract for sale, a buyer (B) pays 1000000 yen for X, but before a seller (A) delivers X to B, X is burned-out due to grounds attributable to B, and A obtains 700,000 yen of the insurance money for damage caused by the destruction of X, B may claim payment of 700,000 yen to A.

R02-15-E.label: N
R02-15-E.query: If, after the conclusion of the contract for sale and before A delivers X to B, X is burned down caused by negligence of a third party, the debt to pay the price of B is extinguished by operation of law.

R02-15-O.label: N
R02-15-O.query: If A tenders the performance of the obligation of delivery of X and B refuses to accept without a legitimate reason,and X is lost due to gross negligence of A while in custody of X by A, B may not refuse to pay the price.

R02-16-A.label: N
R02-16-A.query: In the case that an obligee (C) files an action concerning demand for rescission of fraudulent act, an obligor (A) must be stood as a defendant.

R02-16-I.label: N
R02-16-I.query: If beneficiary (B) sells and delivers X to a subsequent acquirer (D), who knows that the gifts of X will prejudice the obligee of A, C may claim to D to rescind the sale between B and D.

R02-16-U.label: Y
R02-16-U.query: If B sells and delivers X to D, who knows that the gift of X will prejudice the obligee of A, C may claim to B to rescind the gift between A and B.

R02-16-E.label: Y
R02-16-E.query: A final and binding judgment upholding demand for rescission of fraudulent act of C is effective against all obligees of A.

R02-16-O.label: N
R02-16-O.query: If B sells and delivers X to D, who knows that the gifts of X will prejudice the obligee of A and judgment upholding demand for rescission of fraudulent act of C has become final and binding, D may demand the return of the price from B.

R02-17-A.label: N
R02-17-A.query: In the case that an obligee (D) files an action concerning demand for performance of an obligation (X) and judgment upholding the demand has become final and binding, if neither D nor an obligor (B) manifests a particular intention, a new period of extinctive prescription of X commences to run at the time when the judgment has become final and binding.

R02-17-I.label: N
R02-17-I.query: In the case that D manifests the intention to release another obligor (C) from the obligation to D, even if neither D nor B manifests a particular intention, D may not claim the payment of 600,000 to another obligor (A).

R02-17-U.label: Y
R02-17-U.query: If D owes C a debt (Y) of 300000 yen that is set off against the debt (X), and D demands payment of 600000 yen from A while C does not use a set-off for the debt (Y), A may refuse to pay 200000 yen of that debt.

R02-17-O.label: Y
R02-17-O.query: In the case that D owes C a debt (Y) of 200000 yen that is set off against the debt (X), if A, knowing that C is a joint and several obligor of the debt (X), pays 600000 yen to D and claims reimbursement from C without giving notice to C and C duly asserts a set-off as defense against A, A may request D to pay 200000 yen of Y which should have been extinguished due to set-off.

R02-18-U.label: Y
R02-18-U.query: If a deposit claim held by A against Bank (B) is subject to a special agreement that it cannot be assigned, even if A enters into an agreement with G to assign the deposit claim, the assignment will not be effective if G was in bad faith or grossly negligent with respect to the special agreement.

R02-19-A.label: Y
R02-19-A.query: If a third-party collateral provider paid a secured claim, the third-party collateral provider may exercise the secured claim acquired through subrogation without requirement for perfection.

R02-19-I.label: N
R02-19-I.query: If a guarantor has partially paid a secured claim but there is a remaining obligation, the guarantor may independently exercise the secured claim and the security right acquired through subrogation in proportion to the value of the subrogee's performance.

R02-19-E.label: Y
R02-19-E.query: In case that the obligee is found to have reasonable grounds in light of the common sense in the transaction for causing the security to be diminished, the guarantor may not assert that the guarantor is relieved from responsibility to the extent that that the guarantor can no longer seek the reimbursement due to the diminution in the security available upon subrogation.

R02-21-A.label: Y
R02-21-A.query: Unless the parties manifest a particular intention with respect to a claim which bears interest, the rate of the interest is the statutory interest rate as of the time when the interest first accrues.

R02-23-I.label: N
R02-23-I.query: Unless a particular intention is manifested with respect to the place where the performance should take place, even if X was located at the domicile of D at the time of the conclusion of contract for sale, the delivery of X must be effected at the current domicile of B.

R02-23-U.label: N
R02-23-U.query: If B makes an agreement with E to transfer contractual status of the buyer to E, regardless of whether A consents, the status of the buyer is transferred to E.

R02-23-E.label: N
R02-23-E.query: If the contract of sale stipulates that F, who was not born at the time of the conclusion of the contract, is to acquire the ownership of X, the contract of sale is invalid.

R02-23-O.label: Y
R02-23-O.query: If A delays in delivering X after the contract of sale stipulates that a third party (G) is to acquire the ownership of X and G manifests intention of availing of the benefit, B may not cancel the contract of sale without G's consent.

R02-24-A.label: Y
R02-24-A.query: In the case that the seller cannot acquire and transfer the rights to the buyer, if the buyer, at the moment of the contract, knows that the rights the buyer has bought do not belong to the seller, it shall not preclude a buyer from making a claim for damages.

R02-24-I.label: N
R02-24-I.query: In the case that the seller cannot acquire and transfer the rights to the buyer, the buyer may claim to seller compensation for loss or damage even if the case is not caused by grounds attributable to the seller.

R02-24-U.label: Y
R02-24-U.query: If the seller cannot transfer any part of the rights which are the subject matter of the sale because the part of the rights belong to others and it is impossible to cure the non-conformity of performance, the seller may immediately claim a reduction of the purchase money without demand.

R02-24-E.label: N
R02-24-E.query: In the case that the seller cannot acquire and transfer the rights to the buyer, if the buyer, at the moment of the contract, knows that the rights the buyer has bought do not belong to the seller, the seller may not cancel the contract.

R02-24-O.label: N
R02-24-O.query: In the case that the seller cannot acquire and transfer the rights to the buyer, the buyer may not make a claim for damages to the seller in good faith without giving a notice within a year from the time when the seller knows the fact that the rights belong to others.

R02-25-A.label: Y
R02-25-A.query: If a leased immovables are assigned and the status of the lessor is transferred to the assignee,the assignee thereof succeeds to the obligation of assignor to reimburse expenses to the lessee.

R02-25-I.label: N
R02-25-I.query: A lessor assumes an obligation to effect repairs necessary for using and making profit of the leased thing even if repairs are necessary due to any grounds attributable to the lessee.

R02-25-U.label: Y
R02-25-U.query: If it comes to no longer be possible to use or profit from part of a leased thing due to grounds such as loss and this is caused by grounds not attributable to the lessee, the rent is reduced in proportion to the value of the part that can no longer be used or profited from.

R02-25-E.label: N
R02-25-E.query: If the lessee lawfully subleases a leased thing, the lessor may not duly assert against the sublessee the cancellation by agreement of the lease with the lessee even if the lessor has a right to cancel due to non-performance on the part of the lessee at the time of the cancellation.

R02-25-O.label: Y
R02-25-O.query: If The lessee is not obligated to restore any wear of the leased thing caused by the ordinary manner of using and making profit from it when the lease is terminated.

R02-26-A.label: N
R02-26-A.query: A party that has cancelled a mandate, notwithstanding the time of the cancellation, is not liable to the other party for compensation for loss or damage.

R02-26-I.label: N
R02-26-I.query: The provisions regarding mandate of juridical acts do not apply mutatis mutandis to entrustments of business that do not constitute juridical acts.

R02-26-U.label: N
R02-26-U.query: The mandatary may not request the costs that are incurred in administering the mandated business until after having paid those costs.

R02-26-O.label: Y
R02-26-O.query: If a mandate is terminated because the mandator has become subject to an order commencing bankruptcy proceedings, the mandator may not assert against the mandatary unless the mandatary was notified of or knew of the fact that the mandator is subject to the order commencing bankruptcy proceeding.

R02-27-A.label: N
R02-27-A.query: A partner may independently exercise the rights with regard to a monetary claim that is included in the partnership property in proportion to each co-owner's interest.

R02-27-I.label: N
R02-27-I.query: The partnership business is decided by the majority of the partners even if any person is delegated to be a person who executes business.

R02-27-U.label: Y
R02-27-U.query: Even if the duration of the partnership is specified, each partner may withdraw if there is a compelling reason to do so.

R02-27-E.label: Y
R02-27-E.query: A new partner that is admitted to a partnership after it is formed is not liable to perform the obligations of the partnership that arose before that partner's admission.

R02-27-O.label: N
R02-27-O.query: A partner may seek the division of the partnership property before liquidation if the consent of the majority of partners exists.

R02-28-U.label: N
R02-28-U.query: A person who misunderstands due to negligence that the due date arrives and has paid money or delivered anything as performance of an obligation that has not yet fallen due may demand the return of the money paid or thing delivered before the arrival of the due date.

R02-28-O.label: Y
R02-28-O.query: A person who misunderstands that the person is an obligor and has performed an obligation may not demand the return of subject matter of the performance if the obligee, acting in good faith, has lost the claim by prescription.

R02-29-A.label: Y
R02-29-A.query: If a person that holds a monetary claim has borne an obligation for compensation for loss or damage for injury to the obligor of that monetary claim, the person may not duly assert against the obligor, a set-off using the monetary claim against the obligation for compensation.

R02-36-A.label: Y
R02-36-A.query: An act that is voidable on the grounds of a mistake may also be rescinded by the successor of the contractual status of the person who made the manifestation of intention by mistake.

R02-36-I.label: N
R02-36-I.query: The postponement of expiry of prescription period is not effective against the successors of the parties with respect to whom grounds to postpone the expiry of prescription period have arisen.

R02-36-U.label: Y
R02-36-U.query: A universal successor to a possessor may also assert the successor's own possession only.

R02-36-E.label: N
R02-36-E.query: A claim that a co-owner (A) holds against another co-owner (B) with respect to the property in co-ownership may not be exercised against B's specific successors.

R02-37-A.label: Y
R02-37-A.query: If the obligor of an alternative obligation manifests the intention to exercise the right to choose, the manifestation may not be withdrawn without the consent of the obligee even before the due date of the obligation.

R02-37-I.label: Y
R02-37-I.query: The manifestation of intention to cancel may not be revoked.

R03-01-E.label: N
R03-01-E.query: In the event that a declaration of disappearance is rescinded, a person who has acquired property due to the declaration of disappearance must return to the missing person the full amount of the benefits received from the acquisition of the property, even if the person acted in good faith regarding the survival of the missing person.

R03-01-I.label: Y
R03-01-I.query: When a declaration of disappearance is made on the grounds that it has been unclear whether a person who was exposed to a danger likely to result in a person's death is dead or alive for one year after the danger has passed, the person subject to the declaration of disappearance is deemed to have died when that danger had passed.

R03-01-O.label: N
R03-01-O.query: If A, who was subject to a declaration of disappearance and was deemed to have died, had purchased land X from B before the declaration of disappearance was rescinded, this sales contract is effective only if B acted in good faith regarding the declaration of disappearance.

R03-02-A.label: Y
R03-02-A.query: Where a person made a manifestation of intention while knowing that it does not reflect that person’s true intention, even if the other party did not specifically know the true intention of the person who made the manifestation, the manifestation of intention is void if the other party knew or could have known that the manifestation of intention was not the true intention of the person who made it.

R03-02-E.label: Y
R03-02-E.query: If a third party commits a fraud inducing a first party to make a manifestation of intention to a second party, the first party may void the manifestation of intention even if the second party did not know that fact but could have known it.

R03-02-I.label: N
R03-02-I.query: If the manifestation of intention of a person is held void on the ground that it does not reflect that person’s true intention, such nullity may be duly asserted against a third party in good faith acting with negligence.

R03-02-O.label: N
R03-02-O.query: The rescission of a manifestation of intention induced by duress may not be duly asserted against a third party in good faith acting without negligence.

R03-03-A.label: Y
R03-03-A.query: A sent a notice of intention to cancel the contract to B, who is a minor, B received the notice, and B's legal representative learned the manifestation of intention to cancel. In this case, A may assert against B the manifestation of intention.

R03-03-E.label: N
R03-03-E.query: A sent a notice of intention to cancel the contract to B by e-mail, but the notice did not reach B due to a problem with the communication system. In this case, A’s manifestation of intention to cancel is effective.

R03-03-I.label: Y
R03-03-I.query: A repeatedly sent B a notice of intention to cancel the contract, but B refused to receive it without a legitimate reason. In this case, A's manifestation of intention to cancel is deemed to have reached B.

R03-03-O.label: N
R03-03-O.query: A wanted to send B a notice of intention to cancel the contract but did not know where B was, and the manifestation of intention to cancel was made by means of public notice. In this case, even if A was negligent in not knowing the whereabouts of B, the manifestation of intention to cancel made by A is effective.

R03-03-U.label: Y
R03-03-U.query: A died after sending B a notice to cancel the contract, and the notice subsequently reached B. In this case, the effect of A's manifestation of intention to cancel is not impaired.

R03-04-A.label: N
R03-04-A.query: If an agreement is made at 3:00 p.m. on May 16 of a given year that the obligation will be fulfilled within one week, the period commences at twelve midnight of the same day, which does not fall on Sunday, holiday as provided in the Act on National Holidays, or any other holiday.

R03-04-E.label: N
R03-04-E.query: If an agreement is made at 11:00 a.m. on July 12 of a given year that the obligation will be fulfilled within one month, the period expires at 12:00 p.m. on August 13 of the same year, both of which do not fall on Sundays, holidays as provided in the Act on National Holidays, or any other holidays.

R03-04-I.label: Y
R03-04-I.query: If an agreement is made at 10:00 a.m. on June 3 of a given year that the obligation will be fulfilled within five hours,the period commences at 10:00 a.m. of the same day, which does not fall on Sunday, holiday as provided in the Act on National Holidays, or any other holiday.

R03-04-O.label: Y
R03-04-O.query: If an agreement is made at 5:00 p.m. on January 30 of a non-leap year that the obligation would be fulfilled within one month, the period expires at 12:00 p.m. on February 28 of the same year, both of which do not fall on Sundays, holidays as provided in the Act on National Holidays, or any other holidays.

R03-04-U.label: Y
R03-04-U.query: If the last day of the period provided by agreement falls on a Sunday, and it is customary to do business on that Sunday, the period expires on that day.

R03-05-A.label: N
R03-05-A.query: If the obligee makes the second demand during the postponement of expiry of the prescription period granted on the ground of the first demand, the prescription period does not expire until six months have passed from the time of the second demand.

R03-05-O.label: N
R03-05-O.query: When a provisional seizure of immovables has been made, a new period of the extinctive prescription of the preserved claim commences to run at the time when the provisional seizure is registered.

R03-05-U.label: Y
R03-05-U.query: If a demand by litigation was made and the lawsuit pertaining to the demand is subsequently terminated by withdrawal of the action, the period of prescription does not expire until six months have passed from the time of the termination.

R03-07-A.label: N
R03-07-A.query: In the case where A has created a first-ranked mortgage for B and a second-ranked mortgage for C on land X owned by A, and the mortgages were registered, even if C subsequently acquires land X by inheritance from A, the second-ranked mortgage will not be extinguished due to merger of rights.

R03-07-E.label: N
R03-07-E.query: After A sold land X owned by A to B, B resold land X to C, and each of them was registered as such. Later, the sales contract between A and B was voided on the grounds that A was an adult ward. If C did not know without negligence that A was an adult ward, A may not claim that the ownership of land X belongs to A.

R03-07-I.label: Y
R03-07-I.query: After A sold land X owned by A to B, B resold land X to C, and each of them was registered as such. After that, A voided the sales contract with B on the ground of fraud. If C did not know without negligence that A's manifestation of intention to sell was induced by fraud, the acquisition of the ownership of land X is not impaired.

R03-07-O.label: Y
R03-07-O.query: The person who has inherited the ownership of the dominant land alone also inherits the servitude on the land, unless otherwise provided in the act creating the servitude.

R03-08-A.label: N
R03-08-A.query: In the case where A has started construction work to develop residential land on land X owned by A, and a danger exists in the neighboring land due to the construction, B, who lives on land Y can file an action for preservation of possession against A even if one year has passed since the start of construction, before the construction is completed.

R03-08-E.label: Y
R03-08-E.query: When A sells movable X in his possession to B, and manifests the intention to thenceforward possess X on behalf of B, B acquires the possessory rights of X.

R03-08-O.label: Y
R03-08-O.query: When B, who had been in possession of movable X by leasing them from their owner A, made an agreement with A to purchase X from A and transfer A's right of possession, B's possession is regarded as possession with the intention to own them.

R03-08-U.label: Y
R03-08-U.query: If A leases movable X owned by B to C without permission, and then X is damaged due to grounds attributable to C, C who is asked by B to return X, must compensate for the entire loss or damage, even if C believed without negligence that A was the owner of X.

R03-09-A.label: Y
R03-09-A.query: A co-owner of gold bullion may demand the partition of the movable property at any time, if the co-owners has not contracted not to partition.

R03-09-E.label: Y
R03-09-E.query: Each co-owner provides warranty in proportion to each co-owner’s interest, with regards to the thing other co-owners have acquired by the partition of the property in co-ownership.

R03-09-U.label: N
R03-09-U.query: If, in a judicial decision seeking partition of property in co-ownership, the property in co-ownership cannot be partitioned in kind, or it is likely that the value thereof will be significantly reduced by the partition, the court shall order the sale of the same at auction.

R03-10-A.label: N
R03-10-A.query: The extinctive prescription of the claim secured by the right of retention does not run while the holder of the right of retention exercises the right of retention and retains the subject matter.

R03-10-O.label: Y
R03-10-O.query: In cases where a lessee of a building has exercised a right of retention to secure reimbursement of the beneficial expenses after the termination of the lease, the right of retention will be extinguished if the court grants a period of time for the reimbursement at the request of the lessor.

R03-10-U.label: Y
R03-10-U.query: The holder of the right of retention may, with the consent of the obligor, lease the thing retained to a third party and appropriate the rent thereof to the satisfaction of that holder’s own claim.

R03-12-A.label: N
R03-12-A.query: A person may not create more than one pledge on the same movables.

R03-12-E.label: Y
R03-12-E.query: When the secured claim is not satisfied, a pledgee of movables may request the court to immediately appropriate the thing pledged to satisfy the claim in accordance with the evaluation of an appraiser only if there are reasonable grounds.

R03-12-I.label: Y
R03-12-I.query: A pledgee of movables may not have a pledgor possess the thing pledged on behalf of the pledgee.

R03-12-O.label: N
R03-12-O.query: When a pledgee of movables has the right to demand interest on the secured claim, a pledgee of movables may exercise the pledge solely with respect to the interest of the last two years before maturity.

R03-12-U.label: N
R03-12-U.query: Even if a pledgee of movables paid necessary expenses for the thing pledged, the pledgee may not demand the reimbursement for the necessary expenses to the possessor.

R03-13-A.label: Y
R03-13-A.query: If a building is constructed on the land after a mortgage was placed on the land, the mortgagee may auction the building, which is unmortgaged, all at once with the land.

R03-15-A.label: Y
R03-15-A.query: If the obligee is negligent regarding non-performance, the court may deny the responsibility of the compensation for loss or damage, taking into consideration the negligence by the obligee.

R03-15-E.label: N
R03-15-E.query: The compensation for loss or damage due to non-performance may not be satisfied by any method other than the payment of the money.

R03-15-I.label: Y
R03-15-I.query: The obligor may not be exempted from the responsibility on the ground of force majeure with respect to the compensation for loss or damage for failure to perform the obligation of payment of the loan pursuant to the monetary loan agreement.

R03-15-U.label: N
R03-15-U.query: The obligee may claim the compensation for damage which has arisen from any special circumstances only if the party did foresee the circumstances.

R03-16-E.label: Y
R03-16-E.query: When there is an agreement on the amount of liquidated damages with respect to the failure to perform the obligation in lieu of the performance of the obligation, the exercise of the cancellation right on the ground of the non-performance may not be precluded even after the obligor offered to pay the amount of liquidated damage.

R03-16-O.label: N
R03-16-O.query: The agreement on the penalty is presumed to be an agreement on payment of certain amount of money in addition to the compensation for the actual damage due to the non-performance.

R03-16-U.label: Y
R03-16-U.query:
There is an agreement on the amount of liquidated damages with respect to the failure to perform the obligation in the standard terms of contract, and the counterparty of the preparer of the standard terms requested the disclosure of the details of the standard terms of contract before the a standard transaction. However, the agreement on standard transaction was made without the preparer of the standard terms disclosing the detail with no legitimate reasons.
In this case, the agreement on the amount of liquidated damages will not be deemed to be made.

R03-17-I.label: Y
R03-17-I.query: The obligee may not exercise the right of the obligor, if the right is immune from attachment.

R03-17-O.label: Y
R03-17-O.query: The obligor may exercise subrogor's right even after the obligee notified that obligee had exercised the subrogor’s right.

R03-17-U.label: Y
R03-17-U.query: If the obligee files an action concerning the exercise of the subrogor's right, the obligee must give a notice of suit to the obligor without delay.

R03-19-A.label: Y
R03-19-A.query: Suppose that the individual A guaranteed the obligation of B against C. If A seeks to give a guarantee for obligations arising from business of B as requested by B, B must provide A with information concerning the status of assets, and income and expenditure of B.

R03-19-E.label: Y
R03-19-E.query: Suppose that the individual A guaranteed the obligation of B against C. When B had the benefit of time and forfeited the benefit, C must notify A to that effect.

R03-19-I.label: N
R03-19-I.query: Suppose that the individual A guaranteed the obligation of B against C. If the obligation of B guaranteed by A is a loan obligation to be assumed for business of B, the guarantee contract between A and C will become effective by manifesting the intention to perform the guarantee obligation by means of a notarial instrument.

R03-19-O.label: Y
R03-19-O.query: Suppose that the individual A guaranteed the obligation of B against C. If A makes a contract for a revolving guarantee and there is no provision of the maximum amount, the revolving guarantee will not become effective.

R03-19-U.label: N
R03-19-U.query: Suppose that the individual A guarantees the obligation of B against C. When A gave a guarantee for the obligation as requested by B, C must regularly provide A with information concerning whether or not there has been a default in terms of the principal of the principal obligation or any interest, as well as the remaining amount of these items and the amount of those already due.

R03-20-A.label: N
R03-20-A.query: Even if the initial obligor has a right to rescind the act that is the source of the obligation assumed by the obligator on the ground of fraud, the additional obligor or new obligor may not refuse to perform the obligation to the obligee.

R03-20-E.label: Y
R03-20-E.query: When an additional obligor resulting from the assumption of obligation not releasing an old obligor performed the assumed obligation, the additional obligor may demand reimbursement from the initial obligor for the proportion to the initial obligor’s shares of the obligation.

R03-20-I.label: Y
R03-20-I.query: Even if it is against the will of initial obligor, assumption of obligation not releasing obligor is effected by a contract between the obligee and the person that becomes the additional obligor.

R03-20-O.label: N
R03-20-O.query: In an assumption of obligation releasing old obligor, an obligee may not transfer a security right that has been created as security for the obligation from which the initial obligor is released, to the obligation assumed by the replacing obligor.

R03-20-U.label: N
R03-20-U.query: When a contract of the assumption of obligation releasing an old obligor is concluded between the initial obligor and the person that becomes the replacing obligor, the initial obligor and the person that becomes the replacing obligor may assert against the obligee the effect of the assumption by the notification to the obligee or the consent by obligee.

R03-21-E.label: N
R03-21-E.query: Claim X is A's claim against B, and claim Y is B's claim against A. If F, A's creditor, attaches claim X after the due date for claim X has arrived, B may duly assert against F a set-off based on claim Y against claim X even before the due date for claim Y, which was acquired before the attachment.

R03-21-I.label: Y
R03-21-I.query: Claim X is A's claim against B, and claim Y is B's claim against A. Claim Y was assigned to B from another person after claim X had been attached by D, A's creditor. In this case, even if claim Y has arisen from a cause that existed before the attachment, B may not duly assert against D a set-off based on claim Y against claim X.

R03-21-O.label: N
R03-21-O.query: Claim X is A's claim against B, and claim Y is B's claim against A. A assigns claim X to G, and B acquires claim Y after the requirements for perfection of the assignment have been satisfied. In this case, even if claim Y is a claim that has arisen between A and B based on a cause that existed before the time of the completion of the perfection, B may not duly assert against G a set-off based on claim Y against claim X.

R03-21-U.label: Y
R03-21-U.query: Claim X is A's claim against B, and claim Y is B's claim against A. Claim X was assigned to A from E, and claim X was E's claim against B for loss or damage based on B's tort committed in bad faith. In this case, B may duly assert against A a set-off based on claim Y against claim X.

R03-22-A.label: N
R03-22-A.query: If the holder of the right to cancel negligently makes it impossible to return the object of the contract, the right to cancel is extinguished even if the holder of the right to cancel does not know of the holder’s right to cancel.

R03-22-E.label: Y
R03-22-E.query: If no period of time is specified for the exercise of the right to cancel, the right to cancel is extinguished if no notice of cancellation is received within that period, even though the other party has issued a notice of demand to the holder of the right to cancel, specifying a reasonable period of time, to the effect that the holder of the right to cancel is to give a definite answer as to whether the holder will cancel or not within that period of time.

R03-22-I.label: N
R03-22-I.query: If, due to the nature of the contract or a manifestation of intention by the parties, the purpose of the contract cannot be achieved unless the obligation is performed at a specific time on a specific date or within a certain period of time, and the obligor fails to perform the obligation at that time or before that period of time expires, the validity of the obligation will be extinguished without cancelling the contract by operation of law.

R03-22-O.label: Y
R03-22-O.query: In restoring to the original state when the right to cancel has been exercised, if a thing other than money is to be returned, fruits that have accrued on or after the time of the receipt of the thing must also be returned.

R03-22-U.label: Y
R03-22-U.query: If the performance of part of the obligation is impossible and the purpose of the contract cannot be achieved by the performance of the remaining part of the obligation, then the obligee may immediately cancel the contract without making a demand.

R03-23-A.label: N
R03-23-A.query: In the sales contract between A and B, the quantity of the subject matter delivered by the seller A to the buyer B is insufficient and does not conform to the terms of the contract. If the insufficiency in the quantity is due to grounds not attributable to either party, B may not cancel the contract for sale between A and B.

R03-23-E.label: N
R03-23-E.query: In the contract for sale between A and B, the quantity of the subject matter delivered by the seller A to the buyer B is insufficient and does not conform to the terms of the contract. Even if delivery of the replenishment is possible, B may not request delivery of the replenishment.

R03-23-I.label: Y
R03-23-I.query: In the contract for sale between A and B, the quantity of the subject matter delivered by the seller A to the buyer B is insufficient and does not conform to the terms of the contract. If the insufficiency in the quantity is due to grounds attributable to B, B may not cancel the contract for sale between A and B.

R03-23-O.label: N
R03-23-O.query: In the contract for sale between A and B, the quantity of the object delivered by the seller A to the buyer B is insufficient and does not conform to the terms of the contract. If B fails to notify A of the non-conformity in the quantity within one year from the time when B becomes aware of it, B may not claim compensation for loss or damage, unless A knew or did not know due to gross negligence the non-conformity in the quantity at the time of the delivery.

R03-23-U.label: Y
R03-23-U.query: In the contract for sale between A and B, the quantity of the subject matter delivered by the seller A to the buyer B is insufficient and does not conform to the terms of the contract. If the insufficiency in the quantity is due to grounds attributable to B, B may not demand delivery of the replenishment even if delivery of the replenishment is possible.

R03-24-A.label: Y
R03-24-A.query: Gifts on donor’s death do not need to be made in writing, but can be concluded only by agreement of the parties.

R03-24-E.label: N
R03-24-E.query: In the case of gifts with burden, the donor may not cancel the gift on the ground that the donee has failed to perform the obligation that is donee’s burden.

R03-24-I.label: Y
R03-24-I.query: Unless otherwise agreed, it is sufficient for the donor to deliver the thing that is the subject matter of the gift, while maintaining its condition  as of the time when it is specified as the subject matter of the gift.

R03-24-U.label: N
R03-24-U.query: The donee may not cancel the gift with respect to the portion for which performance has not been completed, even if the gift is not made in writing.

R03-25-A.label: N
R03-25-A.query: A entered into a contract of loan for use with B to allow B to make use of building X owned by A. B may allow  third parties to make use of building X without obtaining A’s approval.

R03-25-E.label: Y
R03-25-E.query: A entered into a contract of loan for use with B to allow B to make use of building X owned by A. If the purpose of the contract of loan for use between A and B was for B to hold exhibition Y, it would be terminated when B finished using the building as a venue for exhibition Y, even if the parties do not specify a period of the loan for use.

R03-25-I.label: Y
R03-25-I.query: A entered into a contract of loan for use with B to allow B to make use of building X owned by A. If the contract of loan for use between A and B is not made in writing, A may cancel the contract at any time until building X is delivered to B.

R03-25-O.label: Y
R03-25-O.query: A entered into a contract of loan for use with B to allow B to make use of building X owned by A. B attached removable shelves on the wall of building X upon making use of it. When the contract of loan for use is terminated, B must remove the shelves unless excessive expenses are required for the detachment.

R03-25-U.label: N
R03-25-U.query: A entered into a contract of loan for use with B to allow B to make use of building X owned by A. If B has defrayed the ordinarily necessary expenses with respect to building X, B may demand the reimbursement of the necessary expenses from A.

R03-26-A.label: Y
R03-26-A.query: A person with no authority of disposition may not grant a lease for a term that exceeds the period of the short-term leases.

R03-26-E.label: N
R03-26-E.query: Even if a lessee of land that is meant for cultivation obtains profits less than the rent due to force majeure, the lessee may not demand that the amount of the rent be reduced.

R03-26-I.label: N
R03-26-I.query: When immovables that are leased are assigned, even if the assignor and the assignee agree to transfer the status of lessor to the assignee, the status of lessor may not be transferred to the assignee without the consent of the lessee.

R03-26-O.label: Y
R03-26-O.query: If it comes to no longer be possible to use or profit from the whole of a leased thing due to grounds such as loss, the lease is terminated thereby.

R03-26-U.label: Y
R03-26-U.query: If the lessee of immovables satisfies the requirements for perfection, the lessee may demand that a third party return the immovables when the third party is in possession of the immovables without legitimate title.

R03-27-A.label: Y
R03-27-A.query: A bailment becomes effective if one of the parties asks the other party to keep a certain thing in custody, and the other party gives consent to keeping it in custody.

R03-27-E.label: N
R03-27-E.query: If the parties specify the time for the return of the bailed things, the bailor may not demand the return of the same until the time for the return has arrived.

R03-27-I.label: Y
R03-27-I.query: The bailee may, without the consent of the bailor, have a third party keep the bailed thing in custody when there is a compelling reason to do so.

R03-27-O.label: N
R03-27-O.query: If the things bailed by two or more persons are the same in kind and quality, the bailee may keep these things in custody by mixing them without obtaining the consent of the respective bailors.

R03-27-U.label: Y
R03-27-U.query: If a third party claiming rights with respect to the bailed thing has filed a lawsuit against the bailee, the bailee must notify the bailor of that fact without delay, unless the bailor already knows it.

R03-28-A.label: Y
R03-28-A.query: If monies are the subject of contribution, a partner who fails to make the contribution must pay interest on the same and otherwise compensate for loss or damage.

R03-28-E.label: N
R03-28-E.query: If parties have not specified the proportions of distributions of the partnership's profits and losses in a partnership contract, profits and losses are distributed to each partner in equal proportions.

R03-28-I.label: N
R03-28-I.query: A creditor of a partnership may, at the choice of the creditor, exercise the rights of the creditor against each partner in equal proportions, even if a creditor of a partnership knew the proportion of each partner's share of loss at the time of occurrence of the claim.

R03-28-O.label: Y
R03-28-O.query: A withdrawing partner is liable to perform obligations of the partnership that have arisen before that partner's withdrawal, to the extent of that partner's previous liability.

R03-28-U.label: N
R03-28-U.query: A partner's creditor may exercise the rights of that creditor against the partnership property to the extent of the partner’s interest.

R03-29-A.label: N
R03-29-A.query: If a minor has inflicted damage on another person, the person with parental authority over the minor may be liable to compensate for the damage, but the minor will never be liable to compensate for the damage.

R03-29-E.label: Y
R03-29-E.query: If the contractor inflicts damage on a third party with respect to the contractor’s work, a party ordering work who is not negligent with regards to the order or instructions is not liable to compensate for the damage.

R03-29-I.label: Y
R03-29-I.query: A person who has inflicted damage on another person while in a condition wherein the person lacked the capacity to appreciate their own liability for their acts is liable to compensate for this, if the person has temporarily caused that condition, intentionally or negligently.

R03-29-O.label: N
R03-29-O.query: The claim for compensation for loss or damage for death or injury to person caused by tort is not extinguished by prescription.

R03-29-U.label: N
R03-29-U.query: Even if an employer compensates a third party for damage based on the liability of employers for the employee's harmful act, the employer's right to reimbursement against the employee does not arise.

R03-36-E.label: N
R03-36-E.query: B, who had possessed land X in bad faith , may not claim reimbursement from A for the ordinary and necessary expenses defrayed with respect to land X when land X is returned to A.

R03-36-I.label: N
R03-36-I.query: If the obligor has tendered the performance but the obligee's inability to accept the performance of an obligation results in increasing the expenses for the performance, the amount of increase is borne by the obligor.

R03-36-U.label: Y
R03-36-U.query: The expenses associated with conclusions of lease contracts are borne equally by both parties.

R03-37-E.label: N
R03-37-E.query: A contract of monetary loan for consumption, even if made in writing, does not become effective until the borrower receives the agreed-upon money from the lender.

R03-37-I.label: Y
R03-37-I.query: A guarantee contract becomes effective even if no written document is prepared but the agreement is made by means of sending and receiving e-mail to each other.

R03-37-O.label: N
R03-37-O.query: A bailee of a bailment contract for value not made in writing may cancel the contract up until the bailee receives the bailed thing.

R04-01-I.label: N
R04-01-I.query: A juridical act by a minor who is permitted to conduct business may not be rescinded even if the judicial act does not concern the business.

R04-01-U.label: N
R04-01-U.query: When a minor concludes a contract without obtaining the consent of the person who has the parental authority, the minor may not personally rescind the contract without the consent of the person who has the parental authority until the minor has attained the age of majority.

R04-01-E.label: Y
R04-01-E.query: When a minor concludes a contract without obtaining the consent of the person who has the parental authority, the minor may not personally ratify the contract without the consent of the person who has the parental authority until the minor has attained the age of majority.

R04-02-A.label: N
R04-02-A.query: If an adult ward acquires land by gift, the guardian of the adult ward may not rescind the gift.

R04-02-U.label: N
R04-02-U.query: An act that A, an adult ward, performs as legal representative of B, a minor, may not be rescinded on the grounds of qualified legal capacity of A.

R04-02-E.label: Y
R04-02-E.query: If A, an adult ward, has a right vis-a-vis the adult ward's guardian who manages the property, the prescription period will not expire with respect to that right until the statutory period has passed from the time when A becomes a person with capacity to act, or a succeeding legal representative assumes the position.

R04-03-A.label: N
R04-03-A.query: A manifestation of intention to a person at a distance will not be effective until the other party recognizes it.

R04-03-I.label: N
R04-03-I.query: B, who concluded a contract with A, a minor, demanded that C, the legal representative of A, give a definite answer whether C will ratify the contract. In this case, if C fails to send a definite answer within the period of time fixed by B, C is deemed to have rescinded that act.

R04-03-U.label: Y
R04-03-U.query: The nullity of a manifestation of intention based on the mental reservation may not be duly asserted against a third party in good faith with negligence.

R04-03-E.label: N
R04-03-E.query: The manifestation of intention based on the mistake may not be rescinded if the mistake is due to gross negligence on the part of the person making the manifestation of intention, and the other party is under the same mistake as the person making the manifestation of intention.

R04-03-O.label: Y
R04-03-O.query: If a third party commits duress forcing a first party to make a manifestation of intention to a second party, that manifestation of intention is voidable even if the second party could not have known that fact.

R04-04-A.label: Y
R04-04-A.query: A guarantor of an obligation arising from a judicial act which may be voidable may not rescind the judicial act.

R04-04-I.label: Y
R04-04-I.query: A, a person under curatorship, may not rescind a judicial act by A after the legal representative ratifies the judicial act.

R04-04-U.label: N
R04-04-U.query: If A makes a manifestation of intention of selling an immovable to C because of the fraud by B, the third party, the rescission of that act is made by the manifestation of intention to both B and C.

R04-04-E.label: N
R04-04-E.query: If a loan of money made by A, a person under curatorship, is cancelled, A has the obligation to return the entire amount of the loan to the lender, even if the loan has been spent gambling until then.

R04-04-O.label: N
R04-04-O.query: The right to rescind an act is extinguished by the operation of the prescription if it is not exercised within five years from the voidable act.

R04-05-U.label: Y
R04-05-U.query: The one who acquired Land X after the mortgage had been created on Land X and the creation had been registered may invoke the extinctive prescription of the secured claim under the mortgage.

R04-06-A.label: N
